jobs.description: PT Bank Syariah Indonesia Tbk (BSI) adalah bank di Indonesia yang bergerak di bidang perbankan syariah. BSI merupakan bank hasil merger antara PT Bank BRI syariah Tbk, PT Bank Syariah Mandiri dan PT Bank BNI Syariah. Otoritas Jasa Keuangan (OJK) secara resmi mengeluarkan izin merger tiga usaha bank syariah tersebut pada 27 Januari 2021 melalui surat Nomor SR-3/PB.1/2021. Berikut ini adalah Lowongan Kerja PT Bank Syariah Indonesia Tbk. Komposisi pemegang saham BSI adalah: PT Bank Mandiri (Persero) Tbk 50,83%, PT Bank Negara Indonesia (Persero) Tbk 24,85%, PT Bank Rakyat Indonesia (Persero) Tbk 17,25%. Sisanya adalah pemegang saham yang masing-masing di bawah 5%. Penggabungan ini menyatukan kelebihan dari ketiga bank syariah tersebut, sehingga menghadirkan layanan yang lebih lengkap, jangkauan lebih luas, serta memiliki kapasitas permodalan yang lebih baik. Didukung sinergi dengan perusahaan serta komitmen pemerintah melalui Kementerian BUMN, BSI didorong untuk dapat bersaing di tingkat global. Lowongan Kerja PT Bank Syariah Indonesia Tbk Saat ini PT Bank Syariah Indonesia (BSI) membuka kesempatan untuk dapat bergabung bersama dengan posisi sebagai berikut: 1. Business Development Program (BDP) BDP adalah program pengembangan yang dirancang untuk mempersiapkan talenta terbaik menjadi professional syariah bankers yang kompeten dalam mendorong pertumbuhan bisnis Bank, mengelola hubungan dengan nasabah dan mengidentifikasi peluang bisnis serta akan ditempatkan di seluruh unit bisnis BSI di Kantor Jaringan. Pada program ini, peserta akan mendapatkan pembelajaran menyeluruh mengenai industri perbankan, strategi bisnis, transformasi organisasi, inovasi produk, pengelolaan risiko, hingga optimalisasi proses bisnis. Peserta juga akan mendapatkan pembelajaran terstruktur, pendampingan, serta pengalaman langsung untuk mengembangkan kemampuan bisnis, pemasaran, dan pengelolaan portfolio nasabah untuk mencapai target bisnis bank. Requirements: Lulusan S1/S2 dari Universitas dalam

jobs.description: RDQ427R369 At Databricks, we are passionate about enabling data teams to solve the world s toughest problems — from making the next mode of transportation a reality to accelerating the development of medical breakthroughs. We do this by building and running the world s best data and AI infrastructure platform so our customers can use deep data insights to improve their business. Our Developer Ecosystem organisation shapes how developers and the AI agents working for them build on the Databricks Data and AI Platform, from within the product to the tools they already use. We are hiring an Engineering Manager to lead our declarative deployment framework, which turns data and AI projects into versioned, reviewable, repeatable software. It is one product with two entry points. Third-party developers use our open-source CLI from their IDEs, terminals, and CI/CD systems. First-party, they author, deploy and inspect the same projects inside the Databricks workspace. In both, AI agents increasingly do the work: coding agents drive the CLI, and our in-product AI assistant authors and deploys projects alongside the developer. Thousands of organisations run their CI/CD on it, and it is one of the fastest-growing parts of the platform. The team owns the deployment engine and CLI, the in-workspace authoring and deployment experience, and the metadata service and deployment history that record every deployment. The hard problems are real infrastructure-as-code problems: reconciling declared and live state, making plans safe for humans and agents to approve, keeping visual authoring and code in sync, and shipping weekly releases that remain backwards-compatible for our largest customers. The impact you will have: Lead and grow the team: Manage a team of senior engineers across three closely connected areas (the deployment engine and open-source CLI, the in-workspace authoring and deployment experience, and deployment history and metadata), working with strong tech leads. jobs.title: Partnerships Manager, AI & Frontier Labs
jobs.description: Adaptyv is building an automated lab that lets AI agents run biology experiments. We're entering the era of agentic science where AI models can now design novel proteins, propose hypotheses, and iterate on experimental results. But they can't run the experiments themselves - that's still a manual, months-long process. We're building the infrastructure that gives AI agents access to the physical world. We are one of the fastest growing biotech companies, trusted by leading biopharmas, frontier AI labs, and the techbio companies pushing the field forward. This is a rare chance to help advance some of the most important work happening in biotech today. Our automated lab is powered by a deep software + hardware stack: lab instruments worth millions of USD reverse-engineered into API-controllable hardware, dozens of devices orchestrated through complex workflows, full observability on everything that happens in the lab, processing pipelines for messy physical-world data, and AI systems that troubleshoot production results and accelerate assay development. We’re growing rapidly and are hiring for talented people to scale and support the massive demand for AI-driven wet lab experimentation. About the Role As AI designs more of biology, the bottleneck moves to experiments: running them fast, at scale and with data people can trust. Frontier AI labs and biotechs work with Adaptyv to close that loop, and many of these relationships grow into long-term partnerships. You run these partnerships day to day, from the first project through delivery and renewal, and you make sure each partner gets more value from Adaptyv over time. What You'll Do Run partner projects. You scope experiments and benchmarks with partner scientists and AI researchers, and you keep projects on track with our lab and engineering teams. Grow each partnership. You find the next project, the larger campaign or the new team inside the same partner, and you help shape the terms. Bring the partner’s voice back.

As Germany’s largest provider of online lotteries through our brands LOTTO24 and Tipp24, and a trusted partner of Spain’s ONCE, the second-largest national lottery, we’re shaping the future of the lottery industry. We are passionate about driving innovation, as demonstrated by our newest brands, Freiheit+ and Traumhausverlosung, which bring fresh and exciting dreams to life. Additionally, through ZEAL Ventures, we invest in inspiring e-commerce start-ups like Omaze and DAYMADE, fueling fresh ideas and opportunities. Our team of 350+ professionals from diverse backgrounds is united by a visionary mindset, a passion for collaboration, and a commitment to inspire dreams. At ZEAL, we empower our people to think ambitiously and work together toward a shared purpose: helping people imagine and achieve their aspirations. Your tasks: Evolve, expand and maintain our component libraries on all our platforms (iOS, Android and Web): Angular, Jetpack Compose, SwiftUI fed by a shared design system. Partner closely with our UI/UX designers on component APIs, naming, states, and variants, keeping our code in sync with our Figma library - closing the gap between what is designed and what ships. Define the system's architecture: theming and brand layering, versioning, releases, and a contribution model that invites our domain teams in rather than shutting them out. Maintain living documentation (e.g. Storybook) and drive adoption through pairing, reviews, and migration paths. Make accessibility and responsive behavior built-in properties of our components, not an afterthought. Adopt agentic coding practices and use AI coding agents to accelerate development, while maintaining ownership of technical decisions, code quality, and outcomes. jobs.title: Organic Discovery, Growth Engineer
jobs.description: TL;DR: How people discover Lovable is being rebuilt in real time. They now find software through Google, AI Overviews, ChatGPT, Claude and others, and nobody has the full playbook yet. We're looking for an SEO and AEO specialist who wants to write it for Lovable and turn that visibility into subscribers and revenue. You're technical enough to land your own code and agentic enough to build the tools you need with AI. One sprint you're fixing how lovable.dev gets crawled and rendered; the next you're shipping pages for our highest-intent searches, or an agent that tracks where Lovable shows up in AI answers. Your first instinct is always: will people and answer engines find this, and does it help us grow? Why Lovable? Lovable is the software creation platform that gives people the power to act on the problems closest to them. For decades, turning an idea into software required so much capital, technical fluency, and time that many ideas never came to life. Lovable is the counterargument: a platform for all people with ideas, ambition, and problems worth solving. From solopreneurs to small business owners to teams at companies like Adidas and Zendesk, people have built over 60 million projects on Lovable since its launch in November 2024. And we’re just getting started. We’re building a generational company from Stockholm, with growing teams in London, Boston, New York, and San Francisco. Our team is small, talent-dense, and moving quickly, with a culture rooted in extreme ownership, high velocity, and low-ego collaboration. We look for people who care deeply, ship fast, and are eager to make a dent in the world. Lovable is one of TIME’s 100 Most Influential Companies and has been recognized on the Forbes AI 50 and CNBC Disruptor 50, reflecting our momentum as one of Europe’s fastest-growing AI companies and one of the most ambitious places to build in this next era of software. Our multimodal AI models understand video the way humans do — across sight, sound, and motion — and power production-scale AI workloads across media, entertainment, sports, security, and government. The UK and EU have emerged as critical growth regions for TwelveLabs, with strong engagement from leading organizations including Sky, BBC, ITV, RedBull, Canal+, and Bertelsmann, and we are now building new commercial markets in the Middle East, Germany and France. jobs.title: Product Support Engineer - EMEA
jobs.company: How We Work & What We Value - Ashby
jobs.description: Hello! I’m Allie, Head of Support at Ashby. I’m excited to share that we’re hiring a Product Support Engineer in EMEA 🎉 We’re expanding our global Support team to provide 24/7 coverage across time zones. You’ll join a global team while establishing the technical Support Engineering presence in EMEA, with the ownership and visibility that come from being one of the first Support Engineers across European time zones. We staff across regions rather than relying on on-call rotations; we’ll discuss the specific schedule for this opening during the process. Not sure which Support role is right for you? We’re hiring for both Product Support Specialist and Product Support Engineer roles. Support Specialist owns cases and customer communication end-to-end. Troubleshoots complex issues by navigating internal tooling — audit logs, user experience testing, and API testing — to help customers reach successful outcomes. Support Engineering serves as the escalation point between Support Specialists and Product Engineering. Owns integrations, supports data mapping and data migrations for customers, and resolves escalated tickets that don't require product code changes. Please choose the role that best reflects your experience and interests rather than applying to both. If another Support role seems like a closer match, we’ll consider that in our review. About the role Support Engineering is the technical layer between frontline Support and Engineering. You’ll take on complex issues involving integrations, APIs, permissions, data, reporting, migrations, and workflows—using application behavior, logs, databases, and customer context to determine whether an issue can be resolved through Support or represents a product defect. You’ll investigate issues end to end using tools such as Plain, GitHub, Datadog, databases, and the codebase. jobs.description: Are you passionate, enthusiastic, and looking for an opportunity to grow your career in sales? Are you looking for your next challenge in an emerging and exciting market? The impact you will have: You will join our EMEA Commercial team, part of Elliptic's global Commercial organisation, and champion uncovering and developing new customer relationships across EMEA. As an Inside Sales Representative you will become an expert in Elliptic's value proposition, helping both prospective and existing customers navigate and enter the digital asset market with your knowledge of our product and of the compliance and regulatory environment. You will own the full sales cycle for new business in the Growth segment, and you will grow the customers already in your patch in two ways: up-sell, expanding what an existing customer already buys as their usage and licence needs grow, and cross-sell, introducing Elliptic products they do not yet use. jobs.title: Strategy & Operations Associate
jobs.description: About Act There are over 5 billion users using basic applications today such email, notes, tasks, calendar and they're not AI-native. Our mission is to build proactive applications for anyone in the world, who are not used to complex prompting. We aim to bring intelligence to conversations, errands, organising and workflows, with minimal to no prompting. Our first application is an agent-first mobile communication app. We believe building applications that users use daily for communication, coordination and collaboration needs will help integrate AI into their lives. The net effect is to eliminate misinformation, achieve low coordination costs, enable high quality tasks and collaboration at scale with minimal or little prompting. About the Role You will work closely with core teams on the highest impact initiatives across engineering, product, hiring, operations, and business development. As the company grows, you'll help solve new challenges, build new capabilities, and drive execution wherever it matters most. We're looking for people who learn quickly, think deeply, and enjoy solving difficult problems in a fast-moving environment. What You Will Be Doing Drive high-priority initiatives across the business. Work with leadership to solve business and product challenges. Build new teams, processes, and capabilities as the company grows. Lead cross-functional projects from planning through execution. Research new markets, products, and business opportunities. Improve how we operate by identifying problems and implementing practical solutions. Take ownership of projects and deliver meaningful business outcomes. What You Will Need Strong problem-solving skills and business judgment. Ability to learn quickly and adapt to new challenges. Comfortable working across different business functions. Strong ownership and execution skills. Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills. Able to manage multiple priorities in a fast-moving environment. Curious, resource

jobs.title: Technical Product Manager
jobs.description: About BJAK The original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money. This is the origin of our name. Started in 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, its the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia. Today, we are expanding ways to help people in the region — this includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our mission is help people get more from their money every day. We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities from our offices and remotely, who truly enjoys their work. We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few. If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you. The Role BJAK is building a Neobank Superapp for Southeast Asia. As a Technical Product Manager, you’ll own a product vertical end to end—such as payments and expense management, remittance, insurance, or wealth and trading—from strategy, outcomes, and roadmap through to the technical design and delivery of the systems behind it. This is a product where real money moves, mistakes are immediately visible, and licensing, compliance, and third-party rails are core product constraints—not considerations around the edges. We are AI-native by default, but AI is a means, not the goal. The bar is knowing where a model can genuinely improve an outcome, where deterministic systems must remain in control, and how to build products that are reliable, auditable, and trusted when money is involved. jobs.title: Afstudeerstage technische bedrijfskunde: energietransitie en energie-armoede
jobs.description: Meer leren. Meer doen. Meer carrière. Dat is stagelopen bij Dura Vermeer. Eindelijk kun je de theorie in de praktijk toepassen: jij hebt er zin in, en wij ook! Als stagiair bij Dura Vermeer Bouw en Vastgoed Amsterdam krijg jij de kans om midden in de actie te staan. Geen koffie halen of papierwerk, jij duikt samen met onze projectleider in de praktijk van energietransitie en energie-armoede. Of het nu gaat om het uitvoeren van inspecties of meedenken over interventies: jij maakt impact. Dit wordt jouw stage Wil jij meedenken over een maatschappelijk vraagstuk dat steeds urgenter wordt? Tijdens deze stage duik je in het thema energiearmoede: wat is het precies, waar speelt het en wat betekent dit voor ons als organisatie? Je werkt op het snijvlak van sociaal en technisch en helpt ons om richting te bepalen: hoe kunnen wij hierop inspelen? Je werkt mee binnen één van onze teams en wordt begeleid door een ervaren collega. Je krijgt de ruimte om jezelf te ontwikkelen én om echt impact te maken. Op dit moment hebben wij één afstudeerstageplek rondom het thema energietransitie en energie-armoede Wat ga je doen? Je gaat onderzoeken wat energiearmoede inhoudt en hoe dit zich uit in de praktijk, met name in stedelijke gebieden zoals Amsterdam waar veel (sociale) huurwoningen zijn. Je houdt je bezig met: Het in kaart brengen van wat energiearmoede betekent; Inzicht krijgen in waar het speelt en welke doelgroepen geraakt worden; Gesprekken voeren met corporaties en marktpartijen (interviews, ophalen van ervaringen en data); Onderzoeken welke oplossingen er zijn, zoals passief bouwen, minder installaties of slimme energieoplossingen; Vertalen van jouw inzichten naar een duidelijke visie: waar moeten wij ons op richten en hoe kunnen wij hierop inspelen? Het gaat hierbij niet om de techniek alleen, maar juist om de combinatie van sociale impact, marktontwikkelingen en strategie. jobs.description: Perplexity is hiring a Web Access Engineer for the Crawler team to build reliable fetching and rendering systems for AI-powered search. You'll work on freely available public web content, within site permissions and approved access policies, and develop the infrastructure that supplies content to downstream indexing and retrieval systems. Your focus will be diagnosing network errors, page-loading issues, and incomplete rendering. You'll trace problems from network protocols through client-side execution, distinguish technical failures from intentional access restrictions, and turn findings into production fixes that improve content quality and efficiency at scale. Responsibilities Own fetching and rendering improvements end to end, from investigation through implementation and production rollout, partnering with crawler engineers and SREs. Investigate fetch and rendering failures across DNS, TLS, HTTP, caching, redirects, and client-side rendering, and classify root causes. Improve page loading, completion detection, and content capture to preserve relevant content and handle dynamic pages reliably. Ensure the crawler respects site-imposed access restrictions and rate limits, identifies itself clearly, and retries only transient technical errors. Build tools to reproduce failures, compare crawler output against expected page content, and turn findings into regression tests. Define metrics for fetching reliability, content completeness, and error classification, and use them to prioritize improvements. Qualifications 5+ years of software engineering experience in web infrastructure, browsers, CDNs, or crawling, with strong programming skills in at least one of Go, Python, Rust, or C++. Deep understanding of HTTP/1.1, HTTP/2, and HTTP/3, including status semantics, caching, conditional requests, content encoding, and redirects; strong knowledge of TLS, DNS, cookies, and sessions. jobs.title: Design Engineer
jobs.description: Since early 2024, we've gone from 0 to over 900 customers, succeeding where many have tried and failed before. We have a big mission: to make it wildly easier and more profitable to run and grow a renewables installation business, and through that to make a real dent in the world's carbon emissions and a far better experience for homeowners. We're now looking for a Design Engineer who wants to design & ship exceptional outcomes for users. Most of our product is a front end over hard physics (heat-loss calculations, hydronic design, LiDAR floor plans, compliance that has to be right), used by installers on a phone, with no signal, in a hurry. Making that feel simple is a design problem and an engineering problem at the same time, and this role sits right on that seam. 🌲 About Spruce Almost 20% of the UK's carbon emissions comes from heating homes – there's simply no way to reach net zero without phasing out gas and oil boilers. Right now the only serious alternative is heat pumps, with their almost-magical ability to turn 1 kW of electricity into 3-5 kW of heat (🤯). But the heat pump installation journey is slow, inefficient, and just so painful. This makes it hard for existing installers to grow their businesses and puts off gas engineers from starting to do heat pumps. Perhaps most critically, it means you can't currently offer a heat pump when someone's boiler breaks and they urgently need heating. We're fixing this. We've built a platform for heat pump installers to manage the whole installation journey from initial enquiry through to final compliance paperwork, freeing up their time to focus on what really matters: doing high-quality installations, providing great customer service, and scaling their business. Despite only getting started at the beginning of 2024, we're having a massive impact on installation businesses, suppliers, and manufacturers across the UK: halving the time they spend on each job and doubling their sales conversion rates. jobs.description: About Delinea: Delinea is the identity security platform that continuously controls what AI agents, humans and machines can do and for how long. It extends privileged access management from the point of access to the moment of action, using just-in-time authorization to reduce standing privilege across on-premises, multi-cloud and short-lived infrastructure, without adding friction for legitimate users. Delinea provides visibility across every identity type, scores the risk each one carries, and preserves the context behind access decisions, making them auditable and defensible. It supports both static and ephemeral access, letting teams apply Zero Standing Privilege where risk demands it without replacing existing infrastructure. Über iwell iwell ist ein führender europäischer Anbieter von intelligentem Energiemanagement und Batteriespeicherlösungen (Battery Energy Storage Solutions, BESS). Wir unterstützen unsere Kunden dabei, Energiekosten zu senken, den Energieverbrauch zu optimieren, ihre Resilienz zu erhöhen und die Energiewende zu beschleunigen. iwell hat eine starke Erfolgsbilanz in ganz Europa und eine etablierte Präsenz in Deutschland. Darauf aufbauend startet iwell in die nächste Wachstumsphase in einem der dynamischsten und strategisch wichtigsten Energiespeichermärkte des Kontinents. Für diese Ambition sucht iwell eine erfahrene Persönlichkeit als Country Director / Managing Director Germany (m/w/d). Sie führen das deutsche Geschäft und treiben die weitere Expansion in zentralen Wachstumssegmenten voran. Sie berichten direkt an das Executive Leadership Team und tragen die Gesamtverantwortung für das deutsche Geschäft. Dabei vereinen Sie kommerzielle Führung, strategische Ausrichtung, Organisationsentwicklung und operative Steuerung. Sie treiben das Vertriebswachstum selbst voran. Founded in 2007 and headquartered in Durham, NC, we give merchants, platforms, and fintechs a single API to connect to 150+ payment gateways and 40+ payment methods across 100+ countries, along with the intelligence to decide where every transaction should go. We're vendor-agnostic by design. Our customers choose their providers, keep their payment data portable, and never have to rebuild their stack to adopt something new. Payments are getting more complex, not less. Every new market, payment method, fraud tool, and now every AI agent checking out on a shopper's behalf adds another integration and another decision. Spreedly turns that complexity into an advantage. Our PCI Level 1 vault keeps cards and network tokens portable across providers. Smart routing and retries recover revenue lost to avoidable declines. Fraud and 3DS tools plug in with a single API call. And our payments intelligence turns transaction data into decisions merchants can act on. As agentic commerce moves from experiment to real sales channel, we're building the infrastructure that lets merchants accept agent-initiated payments through the providers they already trust. For the people who work here, that means hard technical problems at real scale, billions of dollars in annual transactions, at a moment when the rules of commerce are being rewritten. If you want ownership and work that shows up directly in your customers' revenue, you'll fit right in. About the Role Spreedly is looking for a Support Engineer to take on our most complex customer issues and bridge the gap between support and engineering. You'll go beyond identifying a bug: you'll investigate where it occurs, explain its impact, and give engineering the evidence and technical context needed to resolve it. jobs.title: Tech Lead / CTO (m/w/d)
jobs.description: The opportunity Tax advisory has everything automation needs: structured data, recurring work, clear rules. Yet the profession never made the leap, because recurring does not mean uniform. Every case has its own twist, and the law keeps moving. Reasoning resolves exactly this variance. That is why the window is open now. The model is no longer the scarce part. Expert knowledge and real case data are, and AI labs pay a premium for exactly this. Vogel holds what no AI-native player has: decades of accounting data, edge cases and judgment calls from several thousand mid-sized companies, audited and closed. It never leaves the house, and it becomes the edge of what you build. The market is being reordered: four in ten tax advisors in Germany leave the profession within ten years, and many of their firms will find no successor. Vogel acquires established advisory firms and develops them further, and every acquisition adds to that base. We have already produced our own annual financial statements with AI. Today, that is one person with a tool. Turning it into a capability of the whole company is the job. You own the technology that makes Vogel AI-first: the data layer above DATEV, the agent infrastructure on top, and the control layer without which nothing in this profession may go live. You decide the architecture and the stack of what we build. What it does and in which order is decided together with Operations and Moritz Vogel in the role of chief product officer, close to the advisors who use it; you shape it with them. You report to and work directly with Moritz Vogel. What you'll do Architecture above DATEV Build the data layer above DATEV. DATEV stays the system of record (for now); the value is created in the layer above it, designed to outlive the system beneath. Choose and build the agent infrastructure: framework, orchestration, versioning, observability. You answer these questions with code, not with a slide deck. About the Team We build the AI agent that helps merchandisers, product managers, and executives grow their e-commerce business: it finds opportunities in their data, tailors insights to each person's role, and takes routine work off their plate by delivering answers where they already work. We are transforming how digital merchandising teams work: instead of digging through reports and configuring rules by hand, they ask in plain language, get answers grounded in their own data, and approve the changes the agent prepares. Customers already rely on the agent to save time and make better decisions. We own the agent end to end, from the first question a merchant asks to the answer they act on. We also own the analytics behind it: the pipelines and cubes for search, browse, and recommendation performance, and the metric definitions merchants rely on. That is why we build the agent and the Customer Dashboard as a platform that every Constructor team extends. We create the foundation that other teams build on: the agent framework, shared components, and infrastructure. On top of it, teams add their own data, tools, and skills, so the agent can answer questions in their domain and the dashboard can show their features without separate interfaces. Each new capability gives merchants more ways to grow their business. jobs.title: Senior Backend Engineer - Search Features & APIs (SABR)
jobs.description: About us Launched in 2019, Constructor is an AI-first e-commerce search and discovery platform that helps shoppers find the right products at the right time and enables leading global e-commerce brands to drive meaningful revenue and conversion gains. About the team The SABR team owns the top layer of request processing for product discovery. We own the service that first receives product discovery requests (autocomplete, search, browse & recommendations) & executes the entire business logic that drives product discovery. That service also functions as a gateway to parse incoming user requests, orchestrate calls across the internal services that do the ranking and retrieval, interpret their responses, and assemble the final response the customer sees. We also own the public configuration APIs customers use to control how discovery behaves, and the MCP layer that exposes all of it to AI agents. Our team owns both platform & product components: Because of the positioning of our services, we take part in every architectural decision of our core product offering. At the same time, our goals are heavily influenced by direct customer feedback, because all product discovery-related features are either implemented in or integrated with our services. All of our services are public APIs, so interface design and backward compatibility are a constant part of the job. But most of our attention goes to keeping them fast and up: we serve up to 15k RPS, fan out to many internal services on every request, and are expected to stay available and degrade gracefully when any of them fails or slows down. The work is distributed systems in practice rather than in theory: request orchestration, failure isolation, caching, latency budgets, capacity planning, and the observability to know what is actually happening in production. jobs.description: We're building the AI operating system for vets. Our AI agent Emma already runs client communication for clinics in 7 countries, including the largest veterinary groups in the world. As Customer Success Manager, you make sure every clinic gets the most out of Emma, from the first setup to the day they can't imagine working without her. You work closely with the founders and the rest of our CS team. jobs.title: Senior Program Manager, EL2 European Tour
jobs.description: About Electra Air travel is about to become something more: more direct, more accessible, and more connected to the places where people live, work and want to be. Every day in the U.S., people make 35 million trips of 50–500 miles, stuck in traffic or routed through crowded hubs. Chances are, you ve been one of them. At Electra, we re changing that with the EL9, a nine-passenger, hybrid-electric aircraft that takes off and lands in just 150 feet. Our Ultra Short technology opens up thousands of new places to fly, beyond conventional runways, congested airports and long drives. We re backed by Lockheed Martin, Honeywell and Safran. Operators worldwide have signed intent-to-purchase agreements for the first 2,200 aircraft we produce, and we re moving toward first test flights in 2027. Getting a new kind of aircraft airborne takes more than ambition. It takes our kind of bold: people who think big while working in the real world. Who move ideas into action and collaborate without silos. Who put people first and make room at the table for everyone. Who challenge one another without diminishing one another. Sound like you? Then look beyond what you thought were your own limits, and help us take flight beyond runways. The Role Electra seeks an experienced Program Manager to lead the planning and execution of a European tour for Electra s EL2 technology demonstrator aircraft. This role will serve as the primary team lead for the EL2 program, partnering closely with engineering, flight test, government and commercial stakeholders, and company leadership to ensure the tour achieves its strategic objectives safely, on schedule, and within budget. After the completion of the European tour this role will transition to supporting EL9.  The exact nature of this support will depend on the candidates specific skills and interest areas; likely options include test team program management, program office support, or leading teams executing government contract What You ll Do Tour

jobs.title: Senior Revenue Operations Manager
jobs.description: lemlist is the outbound platform for sales teams: find leads, run multichannel campaigns (email, LinkedIn, calls), personalize with AI and book meetings. lempire also builds lemwarm (deliverability), Claap (AI call intelligence), Taplio and Tweet Hunter. We're at +$60M ARR, growing ~50% year over year, profitable and 100% bootstrapped, with 180 people. Your mission lemlist and Claap sell through several motions at once: self-serve, sales-led, account management and partners. More than a quarter of our ARR sits in 1,200+ accounts managed by our Customer Success and Account Management teams. In 2027, these teams start working the same portfolio under a new customer segmentation, and expanding our existing accounts, including cross-selling Claap and our new products, is one of our biggest bets of the year. As Senior Revenue Operations Manager (Customer Ops), your mission is to design how our revenue motions run, and own the systems and data behind them. In the short term, your focus is customer operations, from the moment Sales hands over an account to every renewal and expansion. jobs.title: Prevention Analyst - Pentesting
jobs.description: Prevention Analyst - Pentesting About this role We are looking for a Prevention Analyst - Pentester, to join our Prevention track. An attacker does not look at one server in isolation. They look at everything a company exposes to the internet and work out where to start. You will do the same for our clients, taking the attacker’s view of their external attack surface, seeing what an attacker sees, and doing what an attacker would do next. That means reading the story behind an attack surface. A forgotten subdomain, an old login portal, and a misconfigured mail server may each look minor on their own. Together they can show how an organisation has grown, where its blind spots are, and where someone could get in. When you find a potential weak point, you dig into it technically to find out how far an attacker could actually go. This is not a classic penetration testing role. The deep dive draws on pentest methodology and expertise, but it is not a full pentest, and you will not spend your weeks writing long reports. We focus on finding the high impact vulnerabilities that need attention now and getting them to the client in a form they can act on. This is for someone with hands on pentesting experience who wants to work across many customer environments, sharpen their attacker mindset, and grow into owning complex prevention engagements end to end. What you will do Assess clients’ external attack surface as a whole, from the attacker’s perspective. Identify gaps and weaknesses across the surface, not just within a single asset, and work out how they connect. Run technical deep dives into potential weak points to establish how far an attacker could get in practice. Separate what needs fixing now from what does not, and focus on high and critical findings with immediate impact. Turn technical findings into short, clear advice that clients can understand and act on. Share what you learn with the team and actively pick up what others know. We work on problems together. Co

Als Senior Finance Manager Germany entwickeln Sie die Finance-Funktion eines wachsenden Generikageschäfts. Und sitzen mit am Tisch, bevor das nächste Angebot rausgeht. Für die deutsche Niederlassung eines internationalen Generikaherstellers suchen wir eine zentrale Finance-Person in Frankfurt am Main. ANDRIS Consulting begleitet die Besetzung als Personalberatung. Die Anstellung erfolgt direkt beim Auftraggeber, dessen Namen wir im vertraulichen Gespräch nennen. Aufgaben Geschäftsideen bewerten: Sie prüfen neue Produkte und Marketinginitiativen, rechnen Szenarien durch und erarbeiten mit dem Country Manager Empfehlungen für Investitionen. Nach der Umsetzung bewerten Sie die Ergebnisse. Gross-to-net verantworten: Sie gestalten die Prozesse rund um Krankenkassenrabatte und weitere Rabattprogramme, stimmen Forderungen ab und sorgen für nachvollziehbare Rückstellungen, Preisprüfungen und Freigaben. Tender wirtschaftlich gestalten: Mit dem Head of Tender Management prüfen Sie Angebotskalkulationen und machen sichtbar, wie sich Preise und Kosten auf die Marge auswirken. Treasury und die laufende Liquiditätsübersicht für Deutschland verantworten Sie gemeinsam mit dem europäischen Finance-Team. Das finanzielle Fundament sichern: Mit internen und externen Fachleuten stellen Sie Steuer- und Statistikmeldungen sicher, einschließlich Umsatz- und Körperschaftsteuer, und begleiten die Abschlussprüfung. Qualifikation Mindestens zehn Jahre Finance-Erfahrung, insbesondere in Busine

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager LogicSteel
jobs.description: Senior Product Manager LogicSteel Ben jij een ondernemende Product Manager die kansen ziet waar anderen ze nog niet zien? Krijg jij energie van het doorgronden van complexe productieprocessen en weet je deze te vertalen naar slimme, innovatieve softwareoplossingen? Wil jij de vrijheid krijgen om initiatief te nemen, richting te geven aan productontwikkeling en écht impact te maken binnen een internationale, dynamische organisatie? Dan is dit jouw kans! Wat ga je doen? Als Senior Product Manager LogicSteel ben jij dé drijvende kracht achter het doorgronden van productieprocessen en het vertalen daarvan naar slimme oplossingen binnen LogicSteel. LogicSteel is ons cloud-based software platform voor de staalverwerkende industrie. Middels LogicSteel wordt de ontwerpfase, werkvoorbereiding en productie naadloos met elkaar verbonden. Wat kunnen klanten uit LogicSteel halen? Denk bijvoorbeeld aan het automatisch plannen en inkopen van al het materiaal voor productie, het optimaliseren van het proces voor nesting op basis van voorraad en beschikbaarheid, het realtime volgen van het volledige productieproces én het aansturen van onze machines. In deze sleutelrol duik jij in de productieprocessen van staalbouwers. Je kijkt verder dan de dagelijkse praktijk, staat dicht bij de klant en verdiept je in de stappen en randvoorwaarden voor hun productieproces. Door regelmatig klanten in binnen- en buitenland te bezoeken, krijg je scherp inzicht in de productieprocessen, knelpunten en kansen voor optimalisatie. Hierbij doorgrond je welke stappen bepalend zijn, welke beperkingen een limitatie vormen en waar liggen kansen om slimmer te werken? Deze inzichten vertaal je naar generieke, herbruikbare product-capabilities die in verschillende processen waarde toevoegen – van 3D-modeling tot machinebewegingen. Vervolgens werk je initiatieven uit tot concrete productrequirements waarmee Product Owners aan de slag kunnen. Hierbij werk je intensief samen met multidisciplinaire teams om te zorg

Provide technical leadership and guidance to the integration development team. Develop and maintain integration solutions using messaging, SOA and established integration patterns . Troubleshoot, analyse and resolve production issues across integration platforms. Work with Azure Integration Services , including: Azure Logic Apps Azure Functions Azure Service Bus Azure API Management Azure Storage Azure Key Vault Support cloud migration and application modernisation initiatives. Design and implement CI/CD pipelines and automated deployment processes . Work closely with architects, developers, business stakeholders and other technical teams. Participate in Agile/Scrum ceremonies and contribute to sprint planning, technical discussions and delivery. Ensure integration solutions follow appropriate security, performance, scalability and supportability standards. Provide technical documentation and knowledge transfer where required. jobs.description: About Us Gather AI is the Physical AI platform for logistics. We give the companies that run the world’s warehouses ground truth on every product and every movement, dock to dock. Our platform reads the warehouse floor through autonomous drones and cameras mounted on material handling equipment, then turns what it sees into intelligence and action. Facilities run safer and more accurately, with fewer ladders and fewer manual counts. If you want to do the defining design work for a new category in a vital industry, we’d like to meet you. About the Team Product at Gather AI sits at an unusual intersection: we build software for people who work on warehouse floors, not at desks. Our users are associates checking inventory on a tablet from the seat of a forklift, shift teams running drone workflows, field technicians troubleshooting on site, and facility leaders reading AI-generated insights in Sage. Design here is about more than pixels, though craft matters a lot. It starts with understanding how people work under pressure, and it ends with software that gets out of their way and looks as advanced as the technology behind it. Plus de données accessibles → moins de charge administrative, une meilleure coordination des soins et des découvertes scientifiques plus rapides. Depuis 2015, notre mission est de libérer ce potentiel. Nos solutions basées sur l'IA permettent aux professionnels de santé de partager les informations médicales sans effort et aux chercheurs d'accélérer les découvertes cliniques : avec un impact sur des millions de patients en France chaque jour. Alors que nous nous préparons à nous développer en Europe, 2 choses déterminent notre succès : nos équipes et notre mission. Aujourd'hui, plus de 150 personnes travaillent depuis nos bureaux et à distance pour libérer le potentiel des données de santé. Nous avons connecté 800 hôpitaux et 150 000 professionnels de santé, et nous ne faisons que commencer. Nous recherchons des personnes qui embrassent la complexité, veulent résoudre des problèmes difficiles et sont prêtes à construire le futur de la collaboration en santé. ⚡ Notre équipe Sales Public L’équipe Sales Public accompagne les établissements de santé dans l’adoption des solutions Lifen, principalement autour de la gestion des documents de santé. jobs.description: GGZ inGeest zoekt een senior medewerker Financiële Administratie in Amsterdam. Als senior medewerker Financiële Administratie ben je verantwoordelijk voor een zorgvuldige uitvoering en bewaking van diverse financiële administratieve processen. Je speelt een belangrijke rol in het waarborgen van de juistheid, volledigheid en tijdigheid van de financiële administratie. Naast de uitvoering van de dagelijkse werkzaamheden analyseer je financiële gegevens, onderzoek je afwijkingen en signaleer je mogelijkheden om processen te optimaliseren. De afdeling Financiële Administratie bestaat uit 10 enthousiaste medewerkers, inclusief de manager Financiële Administratie, en maakt onderdeel uit van de Directie Financiën. De afdeling is verantwoordelijk voor de controle op en de tijdige, juiste en volledige verwerking van financiële gegevens in het financiële systeem. Vanuit jouw financiële expertise ondersteun je de organisatie bij administratieve en financiële vraagstukken. Hiermee ontlast je behandelaren en andere zorgprofessionals, zodat zij zich kunnen richten op hun primaire werkzaamheden. Wat ga je doen? Je bent verantwoordelijk voor de uitvoering en bewaking van de debiteurenadministratie. Hieronder vallen onder andere het verzorgen van facturatie, het controleren van openstaande posten, het versturen van aanmaningen en het bewaken van de volledigheid van de facturatie. Je stelt financiële informatie beschikbaar voor interne rapportages en levert een bijdrage aan periodieke afsluitingen en aansluitingen met het grootboek. Je analyseert de financiële en projectadministratie, signaleert onvolkomenheden en doet voorstellen ter verbetering van de administratieve processen. Je voert de financiële administratie van samenwerkingsprojecten in het kader

jobs.title: Junior Tester
jobs.description: Ben jij nieuwsgierig naar hoe software werkt en vind je het leuk om uit te zoeken of alles doet wat het zou moeten doen? Heb je oog voor detail, stel je graag kritische vragen en krijg je energie van het vinden van verbeterpunten? Dan is deze functie als Junior Tester precies wat je zoekt! Als tester speel je een belangrijke rol in de kwaliteit van software. Je onderzoekt applicaties, voert testen uit en kijkt kritisch naar de werking ervan. Kom je iets tegen wat niet klopt? Dan analyseer je wat er aan de hand is en zorg je ervoor dat jouw bevindingen duidelijk bij de juiste mensen terechtkomen. Je hoeft nog geen ervaring te hebben als tester. We vinden het vooral belangrijk dat je leergierig, analytisch en nauwkeurig bent en graag wilt ontdekken hoe je software steeds beter kunt maken. Wat ga je doen als Junior Tester? Als Junior Tester houd je je bezig met het controleren en beoordelen van de werking en kwaliteit van applicaties en systemen. Je werkt samen met ontwikkelaars, analisten en andere betrokken collega's om ervoor te zorgen dat software goed functioneert en voldoet aan de verwachtingen. Je leert stap voor stap hoe je verschillende soorten testen uitvoert en hoe je bevindingen op een duidelijke manier rapporteert. Concreet zijn jouw werkzaamheden: Opstellen van testscenario's Uitvoeren van testgevallen Controleren of applicaties werken zoals bedoeld Signaleren van fouten, afwijkingen en verbeterpunten Analyseren van testresultaten en bevindingen Registreren en duidelijk communiceren van bevindingen Samenwerken met developers, analisten en andere stakeholders Meedenken over de kwaliteit en betrouwbaarheid van software Leren werken met verschillende testmethodieken en tools Je krijgt gedurende het traineeship de ruimte om praktijkervaring op te doen en steeds meer verantwoordelijkheid te nemen. jobs.title: Direct Sales Career Program (DSCP)
jobs.description: Direct Sales Career Program (DSCP) adalah program pembekalan bagi talenta muda yang ingin tumbuh dengan para professional, khususnya dalam bidang penjualan/sales. Melalui program ini, Anda dapat menemukan jenjang karir yang progresif dalam bidang penjualan dan dilatih menjadi tenaga jual yang profesional dan berkualitas. Sebagai bagian dari DSCP, Anda akan berperan aktif dalam meningkatkan penggunaan transaksi berbagai produk perbankan seperti namun tidak terbatas pada tabungan berjangka, tabungan emas, deposito dengan metode customer-facing atau langsung bertemu nasabah di pusat keramaian seperti Mall/Event/Komunitas. Kualifikasi: Pendidikan minimal Sarjana (S1), dari seluruh jurusan perkuliahan Diutamakan memiliki pengalaman atau antusiasme di bidang penjualan langsung Memiliki integritas, komitmen, serta kemampuan komunikasi yang baik Bersedia bekerja secara shifting (Senin s/d Minggu) Bersedia bekerja dalam cakupan area Jabodetabek Benefit: Uang saku, Tunjangan kesehatan, Tunjangan transportasi, Bonus/insentif

jobs.title: Software Engineer, AI Coding Tasks
jobs.description: We're looking for experienced software engineers to build AI coding tasks from a codebase they know well. US$1,000 per task, and you can do as many tasks as you want. You turn a real change from a repository you know into a task that today's best AI coding models struggle with: hard for the models, but fair for a skilled engineer. Your tasks are used to measure and train AI coding models. Remote, any location. US$1,000 per task that passes review. Minimum of one task a week, about 10 hours a week. How it works Apply. Complete a short screener interview and upload your resume. Propose. Once you're selected, pick a change from a repository you know and submit a short proposal. We approve it or suggest a better candidate. Build. In our platform, set up the repository as it was before the change, then write the brief, the correct solution and the grading checks. Stress-test. Try lazy, incorrect and shortcut solutions and make sure your checks catch them. Model testing. Run your task against leading AI models until strong models often fail but a skilled engineer can clearly solve it. Review. A reviewer checks your task and you revise it. Most tasks take more than one round. Next task. Once your task is accepted, start another. Requirements 2+ years of professional software engineering Code merged into a public open-source repository, ideally one you know well. A private codebase you own may also qualify (not employer or client code) Strong in at least one of Python, TypeScript, Go, Rust, Java or C++ Solid with Docker, Linux, Git and automated testing Regular use of an AI coding tool Experience writing tests, rubrics or evaluation criteria, ideally for AI models You can explain a change clearly and concisely, in your own words At least 10 hours a week, starting now A secure personal or work computer (no public or shared machines) Nice to have Deep expertise in one area, such as databases, compilers, distributed systems, security or infrastructure Experience building agent
